brief:
A Palestinian-Russian family forced from Gaza is rebuilding across Russia and Egypt while expressing longing to return home, Al Jazeera English reported. The family's displacement reflects the broader pattern of Palestinians leaving Gaza amid conflict and humanitarian pressures.

The report documents how the family navigates life in multiple countries, maintaining connections to their homeland while adapting to new circumstances abroad. Their experience highlights the personal dimensions of displacement for families with cross-border ties and mixed heritage.
dek: Forced from Gaza, a Palestinian-Russian family rebuilds their lives across Russia and Egypt, longing to return home.
title: Palestinian-Russian family rebuilds lives in exile from Gaza
